title: Regent Ysolde's dialogue option 'the burn-order from Tanners' Row' silently and irrevocably resolved the 'Marshal's Oath' quest by handing the evidence to the Regent, who buried it in a locked drawer ('she means the drawer, not the truth'). The option looked like a neutral conversation topic, not one of three exclusive final dispositions of the evidence (vs. taking it to Tarn or Quill), and there was no warning it would fail the quest.
where: Marrowgate, Regent's Chambers / Regent Ysolde dialogue
